entities.summary: Alexander, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with Persian, Hellenistic, and Parthian Mesopotamia (539 BCE–141 BCE). Preceded by Achaemenid and Seleucid Mesopotamia and Persian Empire. Their legacy influenced Parthian Mesopotamia and Ctesiphon.
